title: 新托福 7.11 国内线下 · 听力

questions.stem: What does the speaker mainly discuss?

options.A: A recent discovery about the way ants use their mandibles
options.B: A robot gripper improvement as an example of biomimicry
options.C: A research project inspired by the weight that ants can carry
options.D: A way to package items to make them easier for robot grippers to pick up

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention human fingers?

options.B: To point out what inspired the design of a robot gripper
options.C: To explain how a research study was performed
options.D: To describe how ants' mandibles work

questions.stem: What point does the speaker make about three-plated robot grippers?

options.A: They are not very easy to use.
options.B: They are mostly useful for picking up and carrying flat items.
options.C: Their design is based on an activity observed in ants.
options.D: Their plates usually have at least one curved edge.

questions.stem: What attitude does the speaker express about the researchers' experiment?

options.A: Unsure about why they used artificial hair
options.B: Impressed by the number of items they tested
options.C: Eager to see additional results in the future
options.D: Pleased with how fast their robot grippers picked up items

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The spreading of culture across international borders and its impact
options.B: Reasons for the transmission of Western culture across the world
options.C: The role played by modern technology in connecting different cultures
options.D: The potentially negative effects of cultural globalization

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about American films?

options.A: They sometimes depict foreign cultures inaccurately.
options.B: They frequently include elements of cultures found outside the United States.
options.C: They are an example of how a country's culture is spread across the world.
options.D: They are more popular outside the United States than within it.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker talk about cultural appropriation?

options.A: To highlight a common benefit of cultural exchange
options.B: To present one of the concerns associated with cultural globalization
options.C: To emphasize the importance of social media in spreading a country's culture
options.D: To explain how people from different cultures come to respect one another

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest about social media?

options.A: It is widely recognized as a primary driver of the dominance of Western culture.
options.B: It can lead to cultural homogenization if not regulated.
options.C: It provides a convenient platform for local cultures to gain global exposure.
options.D: It is the primary vehicle for spreading movies, music, and fashion from one country to another.
